newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Dublin airport says gearing up for busiest year ev.
newsitem.headline: Dublin airport says gearing up for busiest year ev.

text.p: The Irish airport authority Aer Rianta said on Wednesday that traffic through Dublin Airport grew by nine percent during the month of March, indicating that almost two million passengers passed through airport during the first three months of 1997.
Aer Rianta said in a statement that these increases have been the pattern throughout the first three months of 1997 and said it was gearing up for the busiest year yet.
The airport authority said all market sectors were performing well and throughput between Dublin and Britain rose by 7.0 percent to 516,821.
Transatlantic traffic increased by 19 percent to 32,424 while passengers to and from European destinations grew by 12 percent to 159,764.
It said domestic air travel in and out of Dublin improved by two percent to 35,704 and transit traffic figures showed the most significant increase as passenger numbers rose to 5,211.
Aer Rianta said UK traffic increased by 10 percent, transatlantic by 22 percent, European by 17 percent and domestic by 2.0 percent.
